messages:
Aisha B: Quick sync on rollout safeguards for regional fallback flags. Main risk: clients with stale caches keep using v2 after rollback.
Tom R: For web default TTL is 60s, mobile 5m. Older SDKs no push.
Evan C: Suggest canonical path: server routing controls model variants; client flags only for non-critical UI. But need emergency invalidation for a few flags.
Nora V: Proposal: introduce a flush-token mechanism per region. SDK polls token endpoint (opt-in) every 20s for emergency flags; token mismatch -> immediate refresh.
Tom R: Polling every 20s is reasonable if opt-in per flag. Mobile can opt-out to save battery.
Evan C: Also add two flag classes: soft (TTL 5m) and hard (TTL 15s + token poll). Hard used only for kill-switches and immediate fallbacks.
Aisha B: Telemetry: emit last_token_check_ts, token_mismatch_count, flag_refresh_lag_p95. Rollout gating: block ramp if token_mismatch_p95 > 30s or inconsistent_decision_rate > 0.5%.
Nora V: Rollback ladder: 1) ops-bot rotate token (forces revalidate), 2) push hard flag, 3) switch server routing to fallback. Each step audited.
ops-bot: I'll add a signed rotate endpoint with audit logging, restricted to ops group.
Tom R: Devex: build small CLI to simulate stale clients and token delays for staging tests.
Evan C: SDK should mark flags "inconsistent" after 3 mismatches in session and call diagnostics hook.
Aisha B: Action items: Tom - token poll spec + opt-in flags (48h). Evan - SDK inconsistent handling (72h). Nora - update rollout playbook with gating thresholds & audit steps (48h). ops-bot - stub rotate endpoint (24h).
ops-bot: acknowledged and will post RFC link when created.
Aisha B: Thanks, folks. We'll run a staging dry-run next week. :rocket:
